collection.description: A visitor's clothing and accent are unfamiliar, but their favorite childhood game is identical to a local one.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A visitor's clothing and accent are unfamiliar, but their favorite childhood game is identical to a local one.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: Both sides insist their version came first and laugh at the impossibility of proving it.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The villagers compare stories without claiming a definite common origin.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A few similarities emerge alongside equally interesting differences.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: A quiet conversation becomes the beginning of a friendship.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (visitor) appreciates hospitality but prefers some time alone.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: (villager) admits they expected (visitor) to dislike local customs.
